author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.19.0 — Fixes rotation sweeps failing to advance to the next room even after 1.18.4: confirmed live that dispatching a new room-clean command while the vacuum is still physically returning to its dock (status: Returning to charge) gets silently ignored -- it just finishes docking on its own and the new room never starts, with no error anywhere. Sweep continuation now waits for the vacuum to actually settle (Docked/Standby) before dispatching the next room, instead of firing a fixed few seconds after the previous one 'finished'. Also adds a safety net that clears a dispatch that never actually started within 10 minutes, so a dropped command can't silently exclude that room from rotation forever.
